name: Annabelle Bockwoldt
headline: CDTM | Consulting on Responsible Product Development | Coaching for Outliers and Minorities
summary:
Driven by a strong sense of purpose, I am dedicated to Responsible Product Development and Social Entrepreneurship. With a background in Venture Capital, Corporate Consulting, and leading a global R&D unit for a listed European market leader, I specialize in driving responsible innovation through Consulting and Coaching.

Outside of work, I co-founded the NGO ThinkTech e.V. to engage in the public discourse on AI ethics and have contributed to this field of research at Stanford University's Center for Human Rights and International Justice. 

I offer workshops on "Responsible Product Development", "Fake News", "Unconscious Bias", and "Responsible Leadership" for universities, accelerator programs, and businesses. 

My mentorship extends through initiatives like Google’s Women Techmakers, the UN's World Food Program, the World Economic Forum's Global Shapers, Female Founders, and more. Additionally, I serve on several Advisory Boards.

Feel free to explore my "Projects" section or reach out directly for more information.

positions.title: Systemic Coach for Outliers, Minorities & High Potentials
positions.description:
My clients oftentimes include individuals with neurodivergent traits such as giftedness and ADHD, women in leadership or tech positions, first-generation academics, and third-culture kids. 

Unlike traditional coaching, systemic coaching focuses on the bigger picture - identifying hidden patterns and structural barriers, enabling my clients to navigate and reshape the systems they engage with.

B2B clients that I work with include: 
Adidas, Aleph Alpha, Aviv Group (Axel Springer), Aware, BMW Group, Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM), Check24, Decathlon, Demyst, DWP Bank, Ecosio, Endo Health, Exide Group, Female Founders / Lead F Accelerator, Formo, GIZ, Gorilla, HERO Software, Honey Sales, Hubject, Hy (Axel Springer), ID‑Now, InsurLab, Lovable, MIRO, Pflegia, Prosoz Herten, RWE Group, Recare Solutions, Salesfive, Sand Tech Holdings, Sinolytics, Smalt, Superchat, The Room, ZEIT Online ...
